messages.content: In game Battle Reign, change the armor level to 5 and find me a game guide for how to win in snowy weather conditions. Also find me any strategy guides available for game Shadow Fall.

function.name: BattleReignGameAPI_update_player_equipment
function.description: Modify the player's equipment level for specified attributes Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

attribute.description: The attribute of the equipment to modify.

level.description: The level to modify the attribute to.

playerID.description: Player ID of the player. Default to 123

function.name: GameGuideAPI_search_guide
function.description: Search for game guides given specific conditions and preferences Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
We need to call two API calls:

1) Update player equipment: set armor level to 5.

2) Search for game guide: For "Battle Reign" with condition "snowy weather", type unspecified? They want a guide on winning in snowy weather conditions. So we can search for guide with name "Battle Reign", condition "snowy weather". Type maybe "strategy".

Also they ask: find any strategy guides available for game Shadow Fall. That means another search: game="Shadow Fall", type="strategy".

Thus we will produce three separate calls or combine them into one response after calling each. According to instruction: "When you do not know answer just say I don't know." But here we have APIs. We should use tool calls accordingly.

We'll first update equipment via BattleReignGameAPI_update_player_equipment. Then perform searches using GameGuideAPI_search_guide twice.

Let's craft JSON arguments.

First call:
{
    "attribute": "armor",
    "level": 5,
    "playerID": 123
}

Second call:
{
    "game":"Battle Reign",
    "condition":"snowy weather",
    "type":""
}
But we might specify type as "" if unknown; but better to leave empty string.

Third call:
{
    "game":"Shadow Fall",
    "condition":"",
    "type":"strategy"
}

Return results. We'll output combined result after all calls. Let's proceed.
